id./param/scenario/cs/a_170_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Oh, there you all are! I'm so glad you're safe! I was so awfully worried about you, I didn't sleep a wink!
"You can drop the act now, 'Your Majesty'!
Veronica snatched the scarf from Frysabel's neck!
...And what's this? A bandage was wrapped around her neck!
"I knew it! That's the burn from my fireball! You're not the Queen at all, you're the witch!
"Oh, dearie me. It seems my secret's out!
"What in the-!? Her Majesty was Krystalinda all along!?
"Hee hee! Thank you for taking care of that pesky power-plunderer for me! Now I'm bursting with energy again!
"And we have some unfinished business. The heroic Hendrik escaped my icy embrace, but you won't get away so easily!
"I know the spell to seal her again, but not while she's at full strength! Weaken her and I'll see what I can do!
